== Summary ==
Final standings of the 2024 Tatooine Regionals in Denver, 9 November 2024. Nine players. [[Joe Olson]] is first, with 12 victory points and a 6–0 record.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 11 November 2024
